title: Maximum capacity of Bartnik data and a generalization of static metrics
summary: Inspired by R. Bartnik's mass minimization problem in general relativity, we investigate a dual problem of maximizing the capacity among asymptotically flat extensions (with nonnegative scalar curvature) of some fixed two-dimensional boundary data. Using the method of Lagrange multipliers on the constraint space of scalar-flat extensions, we derive the variational condition satisfied by a maximal capacity extension. The resulting equation is an inhomogeneous generalization of the well-known static equation, now coupled with the Baird--Eells stress-energy tensor for a harmonic function. We…
